description.value: Gateway to India is an authentic Indian restaurant in Nanaimo serving dishes prepared with imported spices from both northern and southern India. The restaurant offers full dine-in service as well as takeout, with a menu spanning appetizers, curries, tandoor-baked breads, and desserts. Their spice blends and sauces are also sold at grocery stores across Vancouver Island and the Lower Mainland, reflecting the depth of their culinary operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for gatewaytoindia.ca loaded successfully and provides the address (202 Fourth St, Nanaimo BC V9R 1T2), phone (250-755-4037), and confirms the business is open for both takeout and dine-in. The menu page explicitly labels a 'VEGETARIAN OPTIONS' section and one item is described as 'GLUTEN FREE', confirming dietary options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone number; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Indian restaurant in Nanaimo with an active website, confirmed address, and dine-in/takeout service. Useful stop for touring cyclists.
